Patch series ""A few fixup patches for mm""
This series contains a few patches to avoid mapping random data if swap
read fails and fix lost swap bits in unuse_pte.  Also we free hwpoison and
swapin error entry in madvise_free_pte_range and so on.  More details can
be found in the respective changelogs.
There is a bug in unuse_pte(): when swap page happens to be unreadable
page filled with random data is mapped into user address space.  In case

column2: a special swap entry indicating swap read fails is set to the

column1: page table.  So the swapcache page can be freed and the user won't end up
with a permanently mounted swap because a sector is bad.  And if the page

column2: the user process will be killed so that corrupted data

column1: is never consumed.  On the other hand
